title: Invalid patient ages reaching the production readmission model
confidence_explanation: Top hypothesis scores 76% from lineage structure; 2 independent check(s) failed on the suspected asset; lineage resolved 7 asset(s) with no gaps; context came from committed fixtures rather than a live DataHub instance.
summary: 5 of 5 quality check(s) failed. Defect originates in raw_patients in column(s) admission_date, age. 5 asset(s) are in the blast radius, including 1 ML model(s) and 1 production endpoint(s). 2 asset(s) were examined and cleared, and remain in service.

quality_checks.description: raw_patients.age must fall within a plausible human range (0-130).
raw_patients.admission_date is required by the feature pipeline.
staging_patients.age must be validated before feature computation.
staging_patients must refresh at least every 24 hours.
patient_features.age_bucket should rarely be 'unknown'; a high rate means invalid ages reached the model.

root_causes.summary: Defect originates in raw_patients in column(s) admission_date, age
root_causes.reasoning: raw_patients failed 2 check(s) in column(s) admission_date, age, and none of its upstream assets failed any check. The defect therefore originates here rather than being inherited.

root_causes.summary: staging_patients inherits a defect from raw_patients
root_causes.reasoning: staging_patients failed 2 check(s) in column(s) age, last_refreshed_at, but its upstream raw_patients failed as well. This is most likely propagation of an upstream defect rather than a new fault.

root_causes.summary: patient_features inherits a defect from staging_patients
root_causes.reasoning: patient_features failed 1 check(s) in column(s) age_bucket, but its upstream staging_patients failed as well. This is most likely propagation of an upstream defect rather than a new fault.

remediation.title: Add a validation assertion on raw_patients.age
remediation.description: Register a data-quality assertion enforcing 'raw_patients.age must fall within a plausible human range (0-130).' at ingestion time. Measured 37 violating row(s) out of 500. This stops new bad values entering the pipeline; it does not alter existing rows.
remediation.rollback: Remove the assertion 'age-range' from the dataset.

remediation.title: Add a validation assertion on raw_patients.admission_date
remediation.description: Register a data-quality assertion enforcing 'raw_patients.admission_date is required by the feature pipeline.' at ingestion time. Measured 22 violating row(s) out of 500. This stops new bad values entering the pipeline; it does not alter existing rows.
remediation.rollback: Remove the assertion 'admission-null-rate' from the dataset.

remediation.title: Pin production_readmission_endpoint to the last known-good feature snapshot
remediation.description: production_readmission_endpoint is serving predictions computed from degraded features. Pin it to the most recent feature snapshot taken before the defect window so it keeps serving valid scores while the upstream fix lands. Traffic is not interrupted.
remediation.rollback: Unpin production_readmission_endpoint and resume live feature computation once the upstream validation assertion reports clean.

remediation.title: Backfill patient_features after the upstream fix
remediation.description: Recompute patient_features for the affected window once raw_patients is validated, so downstream consumers see corrected values rather than the fallback bucket.
remediation.rollback: Restore patient_features from the pre-backfill snapshot; the backfill writes a new partition rather than overwriting in place.

remediation.title: Notify Data Platform Team
remediation.description: Data Platform Team is the recorded technical owner of raw_patients in DataHub. Send them the incident summary, the failing check results, and the blast-radius assessment.

notes: 2 action(s) change serving or storage state and are held at the approval gate: pin-endpoint-production_readmission_endpoint, backfill-patient_features.
2 cleared asset(s) are protected from modification by this incident response.
